name: store.ezkielyna/public-tools
title: Ezkielyna Public Tools
description: Indonesian public data, QRIS, rupiah and AI model status tools. No API key needed.

tools.name: model_status
tools.description: Live status of AI models on Ezkielyna, one independent API gateway: success rate (24 h), uptime (7 d / 30 d), time to first token (p50/p90), output speed and request counts. Give "model" for one model, or leave it empty for the top N sorted by uptime, latency (fastest first token), speed (tokens/s) or requests (busiest). Free, no API key.

model.description: Model id, e.g. deepseek-v4.1-flash or claude-sonnet-5.5. Leave empty for a top-N list.

kind.description: Optional family filter as used by the status file: deepseek, gpt, claude, gemini, glm, qwen, kimi, minimax, image, video, audio, other.

min_requests_7d.description: For sort_by=uptime: ignore models with fewer answers in 7 days (a 100% uptime from 3 requests means little).

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-6 AI models on Ezkielyna: list price per 1M input/output tokens in USD with approximate IDR (or price per image/second/request for media models), key group, time to first token p50/p90, output speed, success rate 24 h and uptime 7 d / 30 d. Prices are this one gateway's list prices, not a market survey. Free, no API key.

tools.name: usage_leaderboard
tools.description: Most-used AI models on Ezkielyna over the last 7 days (requests, share %, tokens, distinct users) and the change versus the week before. Only models used by at least 3 people are ranked. Users are mostly Indonesian developers with coding agents, so this is one gateway's sample, not national market share. Data CC BY 4.0. Free, no API key.

tools.name: lowest_price_models
tools.description: Models with the lowest listed price on Ezkielyna for a task: chat, coding (models that also work with Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode style agents), image (price per image) or tts (price per 1M characters). Shows uptime next to each price and by default leaves out models whose 7-day uptime is below 90%. Only covers this one gateway, not a market-wide price comparison. Free, no API key.

min_uptime_7d.description: Leave out models whose known 7-day uptime is below this. Models without status data are kept and marked.

tools.name: gempa_terbaru
tools.description: Gempabumi terbaru dari BMKG: waktu, magnitudo, kedalaman, lokasi, potensi tsunami, wilayah yang merasakan, dan link peta guncangan. Latest earthquake in Indonesia published by BMKG ("Gempabumi Terbaru"; usually M5+, can be smaller when felt). Free, no key.

tools.name: gempa_dirasakan
tools.description: Daftar 15 gempa terakhir yang dirasakan masyarakat (dengan skala MMI per wilayah) dari BMKG. The 15 most recent earthquakes felt in Indonesia, with MMI intensity by area. Free, no key.

limit.description: Maximum number of earthquakes to return (1-15). BMKG publishes the 15 most recent.

min_magnitude.description: Optional: only return earthquakes with magnitude >= this value.

tools.name: gempa_m5
tools.description: Daftar 15 gempa terakhir bermagnitudo 5.0 ke atas dari BMKG, dengan potensi tsunami. The 15 most recent M 5.0+ earthquakes in and around Indonesia, with tsunami potential. Free, no key.

limit.description: Maximum number of earthquakes to return (1-15). BMKG publishes the 15 most recent.

min_magnitude.description: Optional: only return earthquakes with magnitude >= this value.

tools.name: prakiraan_cuaca
tools.description: Prakiraan cuaca BMKG per kelurahan/desa (per 3 jam, hingga 3 hari): kondisi, suhu, kelembapan, angin, tutupan awan. Needs the Kemendagri village code "adm4" (format 00.00.00.0000, e.g. 31.71.03.1001 = Kemayoran, Jakarta Pusat). BMKG weather forecast for an Indonesian village, 3-hourly for up to 3 days. Free, no key.

days.description: How many calendar days to return (1-3), counted from the first forecast date (today, local time). Default 3.

tools.name: daftar_libur
tools.description: Daftar libur nasional dan cuti bersama Indonesia per tahun (opsional per bulan), sesuai SKB 3 Menteri, lengkap dengan nomor SKB dan sumber. Lists Indonesian national public holidays and collective leave for 2025, 2026, 2027. Offline, free.

include_cuti_bersama.description: Include cuti bersama (collective leave). Default true.

tools.name: cek_tanggal
tools.description: Cek apakah suatu tanggal libur nasional, cuti bersama, akhir pekan, atau hari kerja, beserta alasannya. Checks whether a date is a holiday, weekend or working day in Indonesia, with the reason. Default date: today (Asia/Jakarta).

date.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD (also DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, or "today"/"hari ini" in Asia/Jakarta). Default today.

cuti_bersama_off.description: Treat cuti bersama (collective leave) as a day off. Default true. Set false for businesses that work on cuti bersama.

saturday_working.description: Saturday is a working day (6-day work week). Default false. National holidays on Saturday stay off.

tools.name: hitung_hari_kerja
tools.description: Menghitung jumlah hari kerja di antara dua tanggal (tidak termasuk akhir pekan, libur nasional, dan opsional cuti bersama). Counts Indonesian working days between two dates, inclusive of both by default. Reversed ranges are swapped.

start.description: Start date. Date as YYYY-MM-DD (also DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, or "today"/"hari ini" in Asia/Jakarta).

end.description: End date (inclusive). Date as YYYY-MM-DD (also DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, or "today"/"hari ini" in Asia/Jakarta).

count_start.description: Count the start date itself. Default true. Set false for "working days after start, up to and including end".

cuti_bersama_off.description: Treat cuti bersama (collective leave) as a day off. Default true. Set false for businesses that work on cuti bersama.

saturday_working.description: Saturday is a working day (6-day work week). Default false. National holidays on Saturday stay off.

tools.name: hari_kerja_berikutnya
tools.description: Tanggal setelah N hari kerja dari suatu tanggal (untuk SLA, tenggat, estimasi pengiriman). N negatif = mundur. N=0 = hari kerja terdekat. Adds N Indonesian working days to a date (start date not counted), skipping weekends, holidays and optionally cuti bersama.

date.description: Start date. Date as YYYY-MM-DD (also DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, or "today"/"hari ini" in Asia/Jakarta). Default today.

n.description: Working days to add (negative = go back, 0 = this date if it is a working day, else the next one).

cuti_bersama_off.description: Treat cuti bersama (collective leave) as a day off. Default true. Set false for businesses that work on cuti bersama.

saturday_working.description: Saturday is a working day (6-day work week). Default false. National holidays on Saturday stay off.

tools.name: parse_qris
tools.description: Membongkar teks QRIS menjadi field bernama. Decodes a QRIS / EMVCo merchant-presented QR payload into named fields: static or dynamic, merchant accounts (tags 26-51, incl. NMID in the national QRIS template), MCC, currency, amount, tip/fee, country, merchant name/city, postal code, additional data (tag 62), language template and the CRC check. Offline, nothing is sent anywhere.

qris.description: The QRIS payload text (starts with "000201" and ends with "6304" + 4 hex characters). Paste text, not an image.

tools.name: validate_qris
tools.description: Memeriksa struktur dan CRC QRIS. Validates a QRIS payload: TLV structure, mandatory fields, value formats and the CRC-16/CCITT (init 0xFFFF) checksum. Reports every problem found (errors and warnings) with a code and a fix hint. Offline.

qris.description: The QRIS payload text (starts with "000201" and ends with "6304" + 4 hex characters). Paste text, not an image.

tools.name: set_qris_amount
tools.description: Mengubah QRIS STATIS menjadi DINAMIS dengan nominal Rupiah. Turns a valid STATIC QRIS into a DYNAMIC one with a fixed amount in whole Rupiah: sets tag 01 to 12, inserts tag 54, optionally adds a tip/fee (tags 55-57, off by default) and recomputes the CRC. Refuses invalid or already-dynamic input. This only rewrites text: it does not move money, and the result is only as valid as the merchant's static code.

qris.description: The merchant's own STATIC QRIS payload text.

amount.description: Amount in whole Rupiah, e.g. 15000 or "15.000". Max 13 digits.

tip.description: Tip/convenience fee: none (default), prompt (payer types a tip, 55=01), fixed (55=02 + 56), percent (55=03 + 57).

tip_value.description: For tip=fixed: whole Rupiah. For tip=percent: 0.01-99.99.

allow_dynamic_input.description: Allow a QRIS that is already dynamic (its amount is replaced). Off by default because dynamic codes are usually single-use.

tools.name: qris_to_svg
tools.description: Membuat gambar QR code (SVG) dari teks QRIS yang valid. Renders a valid QRIS payload as an SVG QR code (byte mode, error correction L/M/Q/H, default M). Built-in encoder, no dependencies, offline. Refuses invalid QRIS. Always test-scan the result before printing.

qris.description: The QRIS payload text (starts with "000201" and ends with "6304" + 4 hex characters). Paste text, not an image.

module_px.description: Pixels per module (width/height attributes only; the SVG scales).

tools.name: terbilang
tools.description: Mengubah angka menjadi kata-kata Bahasa Indonesia (terbilang) untuk kuitansi/invoice. Converts a number to Indonesian words: up to 999 kuadriliun, decimals with "koma", negatives, optional "rupiah" suffix and "sen", correct seratus/seribu/sebelas rules. Example: 1500 -> "seribu lima ratus".

angka.description: A JSON number, or text such as "1250000", "Rp1.250.000,50" or "1,5 jt". Send very large numbers (>= 2^53) as text.

sen.description: With rupiah=true: read up to 2 decimals as sen ("... rupiah lima puluh sen") instead of "koma".

huruf.description: Letter case: kecil (lower), awal (first letter), judul (Title Case), besar (UPPER).

tools.name: format_rupiah
tools.description: Memformat angka sebagai Rupiah gaya Indonesia. Formats a number as Rupiah: "Rp1.234.567,89" (dot thousands, comma decimals), with or without "Rp", fixed decimals, ",-" suffix, or compact like "Rp1,2 jt" / "Rp1,2 juta".

angka.description: A JSON number, or text such as "1250000", "Rp1.250.000,50" or "1,5 jt". Send very large numbers (>= 2^53) as text.

desimal.description: Decimals 0-4, or "auto" (default: 0 for whole numbers, else 2). Rounds half up.

spasi.description: Space after Rp ("Rp 1.000"). Indonesian spelling rules (EYD) write it without a space.

ringkas.description: Compact: rb / jt / M / T (e.g. "Rp1,2 jt").

ringkas_desimal.description: Max decimals in compact mode (trailing zeros dropped).

ringkas_panjang.description: Compact with full words: ribu / juta / miliar / triliun.

tools.name: parse_rupiah
tools.description: Membaca nominal dari teks berantakan. Extracts a number from messy text: "Rp 1.250.000,-", "IDR 50k", "1,5 jt", "2.5M", "(Rp1.000)", "Total: Rp1.234.567,89" or words like "dua juta lima ratus ribu rupiah". Indonesian conventions first ("." thousands, "," decimal); ambiguities are reported.

tools.name: hitung_ppn
tools.description: Menghitung PPN Indonesia (aturan 2025+). Computes Indonesian VAT (PPN) from the price before tax, from DPP nilai lain, or backwards from a total that includes PPN. Default kategori nonmewah = 12% x DPP nilai lain 11/12 (effective 11%, PMK 131/2024 Pasal 3); mewah = 12% x price (Pasal 2); custom = your own rate/factor. Returns harga jual, DPP, PPN, total, the rule used and its source. Calculation aid, not tax advice.

nilai.description: A JSON number, or text such as "1250000", "Rp1.250.000,50" or "1,5 jt". Send very large numbers (>= 2^53) as text.

dari.description: What "nilai" is: harga_jual (price/penggantian before PPN, default), dpp_nilai_lain (already the DPP), total (price including PPN).

kategori.description: nonmewah (default, 12% x 11/12), mewah (luxury goods, 12% x price) or custom (needs tarif_persen).

tarif_persen.description: Only for kategori=custom: rate in percent, e.g. 11 or "1,1".

faktor_dpp.description: Only for kategori=custom: DPP factor, e.g. "11/12", 0.9 or "90%" (default 1).

pembulatan.description: Round PPN to whole Rupiah: tidak (no, show sen), bawah (down), terdekat (nearest), atas (up).

tools.name: cari_wilayah
tools.description: Mencari provinsi, kabupaten/kota, kecamatan atau desa/kelurahan berdasarkan nama (tahan salah ketik). Searches Indonesian administrative regions by name (typo tolerant) and returns the Kemendagri code plus the full path, e.g. "Desa X, Kec. Y, Kab. Z, Prov. W". Extra words can name a parent ("gambir jakarta pusat"). Offline, free.

nama.description: Nama wilayah / region name, e.g. "Kemayoran", "kab bandung", "desa sukamaju garut". Max 200 chars.

tingkat.description: Optional level: 1 provinsi, 2 kabupaten/kota, 3 kecamatan, 4 desa/kelurahan.

kode_induk.description: Optional parent code to search inside, e.g. "32" (Jawa Barat) or "32.05" (Kab. Garut).

tools.name: detail_kode
tools.description: Menjelaskan satu kode wilayah: nama, jenis, semua induknya dan jumlah wilayah di bawahnya. Returns the name, kind, all parents (province down) and child count of a Kemendagri region code. Accepts 31.71.03.1001 or 3171031001. Level-4 codes are also the BMKG "adm4" codes. Offline, free.

tools.name: daftar_anak
tools.description: Mendaftar wilayah satu tingkat di bawah kode (provinsi → kab/kota → kecamatan → desa/kelurahan), dengan halaman. Lists the direct children of a code, paginated with offset/batas. Without kode it lists the 38 provinces. Offline, free.

kode.description: Parent code, e.g. "32" or "32.73.01". Leave empty for all provinces.

offset.description: Start position (use next_offset from the previous page).

tools.name: validasi_kode
tools.description: Memeriksa format kode wilayah Kemendagri dan apakah kode itu ada di data Kepmendagri terbaru. Checks the format of a region code and whether it exists in the current list; for unknown codes it reports the nearest existing parent. Offline, free.
